minutes.headline: Zoning board granted a special permit modification for an 8-bay service garage and paved lot at the Chase Road dealerships.
minutes.summary: The board heard Empire Management's request to modify special permits for the North End Mazda and Subaru dealerships on Chase Road, adding a service garage and paving a gravel storage lot. A neighbor raised concerns about oil and debris near his property line, and the board said that is a matter for the Conservation Commission. The board then voted on the modification, continued and voted on a 270 Electric special permit, and adjourned.

what_happened.line: The board voted on a request to amend the special permit for the Chase Road dealerships, subject to the terms and conditions of other boards; the minutes do not record the result audibly.
The board heard a request to add a service garage and pave a gravel storage lot at the North End Mazda and Subaru dealerships.
A neighbor said oil pools, barrels and tires lie near the stream bank at his property line and asked for cleanup before more is built.
Fire department approval of the parking layout is to be a permit condition, rather than a fixed vehicle number.
The board also voted on the 270 Electric special permit after a continued hearing; the result is not audible in the minutes.
